title: Keyboard focus containment + bilingual contrast guide for compact dashboard widgets
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and prototype a keyboard-first focus containment pattern and a bilingual (English/French) contrast guidance sheet for the compact dashboard widget family (metric cards, mini-rollout inspector, compact heatmap). Goals: 1) ensure predictable tab order and containment for nested widget popovers and rollout variant panes; 2) provide contrast token recommendations for iconography, badges, and microcopy at compact sizes across two locales; 3) produce a Figma prototype and acceptance checklist for engineering handoff and QA. Work includes accessibility usability testing with 6 internal keyboard-only users, dev review with Rendering team to confirm CSS containment options, and an implementation checklist for QA and localization engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Tab sequence across compact widgets is deterministic and reversible (Shift+Tab returns to previous focus) in desktop and tablet viewport breakpoints
When a rollout inspector is opened from a widget, keyboard focus is trapped within the inspector until closed, and focus returns to the original invoking control
All iconography and badge text in compact widgets meet a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background in both English and French locales for default and high-contrast tokens
Number formatting and localized unit suffixes (e.g., ‘k’ vs localized abbreviations) are correctly announced by screen readers for en-US and fr-FR test cases
Figma prototype linked, implementation notes reviewed by Eng, and a small-batch QA run (10 seeded cases) passes with no critical issues
decisions: Use a lightweight focus containment pattern (aria-hidden swap + focus trapping) rather than persistent DOM reordering to minimize layout thrash on GPUs
Adopt existing color token pairs from the global contrast ramp but add two compact-size overrides: icon-compact-foreground and badge-compact-bg to guarantee >=4.5:1
Announce localized units using a data-l10n attribute and a small i18n helper function to avoid hard-coded suffixes in markup
Avoid full-screen modal semantics for rollout inspectors; use role=dialog with aria-modal=true only for expanded, persistent inspectors to preserve toolbar hotkeys
feedback: PM (Roxana): prioritize focus-return behavior over animation polish for initial rollout—users need reliable place to continue work
Eng (Marco): prefer CSS containment + inert polyfill where supported; flagged potential conflict with existing continuous-batching focus manager—follow-up with Runtime infra team
A11y reviewer (Evelyn): suggested adding aria-live polite region for dynamic numeric updates in metric cards so screen readers announce value deltas
Intl reviewer (Julien): requested sample translations for French compact unit abbreviations and edge cases for non-breaking spaces in narrow layouts
next_steps: Finalize Figma frames for tablet and desktop compact widgets and annotate focusable stops
Engineering spike to validate inert polyfill performance on dedicated instances and confirm no KV cache regressions
Produce implementation ticket for rendering team with annotated CSS token changes and small CSS variables map
Coordinate with Localization to add unit-abbrev entries for fr-FR and run a 5-case screen reader regression
Schedule QA session (internal accessibility testers) week of 2025-03-10 and capture logs/screenshots for each seeded case
